# LetitEdit

> LetitEdit is a free, browser-based tool site for editing images, video, audio and screen recordings. The 14 published tools need no account. Most process files entirely in the browser; the AI Background Remover uses Cloudflare Images for the first result only after explicit consent, then a verified local AI model on later visits. The site also publishes 28 category pages covering image, video, audio, PDF, design, document and web topics.

Canonical site: https://letitedit.com/

## Live tools

- [Image & Photo Editor](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/image-photo-editor/): Crop, resize, rotate, adjust colour, add text or shapes, apply filters and export images.
- [Image Size Compressor](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/image-size-compressor/): Reduce JPG, PNG and WebP file sizes while keeping dimensions and transparency.
- [AI Background Remover](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/background-remover/): Remove backgrounds with Cloudflare Images on first use after consent, then a local BiRefNet model; refine edges and export PNG, JPG or WebP.
- [Video Editor](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/video-editor/): Trim, add text, music, filters and motion, then export MP4 or WebM.
- [Video Trimmer](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/video-trimmer/): Cut or remove an exact section of a video and download the result.
- [Video Merger](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/video-merger/): Combine clips, reorder them and choose output settings.
- [Video Cropper](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/video-cropper/): Crop to custom areas or ready-made aspect ratios for social platforms.
- [Video Resizer](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/video-resizer/): Resize to 4K, 1080p, 720p or a custom resolution.
- [Video Compressor](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/video-compressor/): Shrink MP4, WebM, MOV, M4V and MKV files with presets or a target size.
- [Video Converter](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/video-converter/): Convert video to MP4, WebM, MOV or MKV, or extract MP3 audio.
- [Audio Trimmer](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/audio-trimmer/): Cut audio precisely on the waveform and export WAV or MP3.
- [Audio Merger](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/audio-merger/): Join tracks, reorder them and add gaps or crossfades.
- [Audio Converter](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/audio-converter/): Convert MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A/AAC, OGG/Opus and AIFF with batch support.
- [Screen Recorder](https://letitedit.com/media-and-motion/screen-recorder/): Record a screen, tab or window with microphone, system audio and webcam overlay.

## Categories

- [Image & Photo Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/image-photo-editing/): Cropping, resizing, compressing, retouching and exporting photos.
- [Video Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/video-editing/): Trimming, merging, cropping, resizing, compressing and converting video.
- [Audio & Music Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/audio-music-editing/): Trimming, merging and converting audio files.
- [PDF & Document Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/pdf-document-editing/): PDF and document editing topics.
- [Text & Writing Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/text-writing-editing/): Text cleanup, writing and Unicode-aware editing.
- [Graphic Design & Creative Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/graphic-design-creative-editing/): Creative layouts, graphics and design projects.
- [Web & Code Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/web-code-editing/): Web, code and developer-focused editing topics.
- [Diagram, Presentation & Productivity Design](https://letitedit.com/categories/diagram-presentation-productivity-design/): Diagrams, presentations and planning layouts.
- [QR, Barcode & Utility Design](https://letitedit.com/categories/qr-barcode-utility-design/): QR codes, barcodes and small utility design.
- [Face & Portrait Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/face-portrait-editing/): Portrait retouching, lighting and background topics.
- [AI Image Enhancement & Restoration](https://letitedit.com/categories/ai-image-enhancement-restoration/): Upscaling, restoration, sharpening and photo repair.
- [3D Design & Model Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/3d-design-model-editing/): 3D model viewing, conversion and optimisation.
- [Animation & Motion Graphics](https://letitedit.com/categories/animation-motion-graphics/): GIF, motion, SVG and frame-by-frame animation.
- [Font & Typography Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/font-typography-editing/): Font preview, pairing, conversion and typography.
- [Color & Gradient Tools](https://letitedit.com/categories/color-gradient-tools/): Colour pickers, palettes, gradients and contrast.
- [Logo & Branding Tools](https://letitedit.com/categories/logo-branding-tools/): Logos, favicons, watermarks and brand kits.
- [Social Media Design Tools](https://letitedit.com/categories/social-media-design-tools/): Posts, stories, banners and social profiles.
- [Screenshot & Screen Image Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/screenshot-screen-image-editing/): Screenshot annotation, redaction and device frames.
- [Data Visualization & Infographic Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/data-visualization-infographic-editing/): Charts, graphs, timelines and infographics.
- [eBook & Publishing Tools](https://letitedit.com/categories/ebook-publishing-tools/): eBook editing, EPUB conversion and publishing.
- [Email & Newsletter Design](https://letitedit.com/categories/email-newsletter-design/): Email templates, newsletters and responsive previews.
- [Sound Effects & Voice Design](https://letitedit.com/categories/sound-effects-voice-design/): Sound effects, voice, pitch and audio visualisation.
- [CAD & Technical Drawing](https://letitedit.com/categories/cad-technical-drawing/): CAD viewing, DXF, measurement and technical drawing.
- [Signature & Document Annotation](https://letitedit.com/categories/signature-document-annotation/): Digital signatures, stamps and document markup.
- [UI/UX & Website Design Tools](https://letitedit.com/categories/ui-ux-website-design-tools/): Wireframes, mockups, CSS and responsive design.
- [Print & Marketing Material Design](https://letitedit.com/categories/print-marketing-material-design/): Flyers, posters, brochures and print layouts.
- [Metadata & File Information Editing](https://letitedit.com/categories/metadata-file-information-editing/): EXIF, media tags and file property details.
- [Digital Drawing & Illustration](https://letitedit.com/categories/digital-drawing-illustration/): Drawing, vector, pixel art and illustration.
